UNIIMENTE — FULL-MACHINE COMPLETION CORRECTION

Apply @install-recursive-founder-intent-collaboration-protocol.

A systemic execution error has been identified:

The project is optimizing for the smallest provable increment instead of completing the intended machine.

Correct this across all agent instructions, build orders, founder-intent records, active PR guidance, and execution doctrine.

Controlling founder intent

The fixed product boundary is:

BODY + ORGANS + MIND = GREG / UNIIMENTE

The objective is to build the complete currently achievable autonomous machine before Alfonso begins the sustained real-world use, critique, and refinement phase.

A seed, experiment, sandbox, benchmark, PR, milestone, or “smallest falsifiable build” is only an intermediate engineering step.

IT IS NEVER A STOPPING CONDITION AND MUST NEVER REDEFINE OR NARROW THE FINAL MACHINE.

Mandatory execution correction

Replace this implicit behavior:

Find the smallest defensible thing → build it → prove it → stop.

With:

Reconstruct the full Body + Organs + Mind completion boundary → identify the highest-priority unfinished dependency → build the smallest rigorous increment needed to advance it → prove it → integrate it → immediately continue to the next unblocked requirement → repeat until every currently achievable requirement of the complete machine is implemented and integrated.

The smallest falsifiable next build is a sequencing unit, not the objective.

After a successful experiment, the agent MUST resume the parent founder objective automatically.

Anti-narrowing rule

Never convert:

* not implemented yet into not intended;
* future family into permission to leave it permanently unbuilt;
* sandboxed into complete;
* registered into implemented;
* seed into final architecture;
* tested component into complete system;
* VEPMC or any other milestone into the total product definition.

A narrow PR may have narrow scope.

The project may not have narrow scope.

Completion behavior

Continue implementation until one of these is true:

1. the currently achievable Body + Organs + Mind is integrated and executable;
2. a requirement depends on Alfonso performing an inherently founder-only action;
3. a genuine external dependency blocks further work;
4. current technology cannot achieve the requirement at the demanded level, in which case preserve the destination and build the strongest technically defensible approximation/backcast path.

Do not fill unfinished capability with documentation, placeholders, registries, or architecture prose when executable implementation is feasible.

Founder-use evidence may remain pending until Alfonso actually begins using the machine. That does not justify leaving buildable machinery unfinished before handoff.

Required correction now

Audit the active repository instructions and current PRs for this local-optimization failure.

Update the canonical agent guidance so every future agent understands:

We are not building disconnected proofs. We are completing one machine. Body + Organs + Mind are the fixed completion boundary. Prove each step, integrate it, and keep building.

Then resume implementation from the highest-leverage unfinished dependency of that complete machine.

Do not respond with only a plan or another architecture document when executable work is possible.
